ModMetaData.name: Niceties
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
Small colony comforts vanilla never shipped. Each nicety is its own toggle: well-kept apparel, throne-room altars, any outfit cut, hidden cryptosleep, melee hunting, shared bedrooms, and leave a way out.
Requires Harmony. RimWorld 1.6. Royalty and Ideology optional. Safe to add or remove mid-save.
Full notes: https://azraelgodking.github.io/rimworld_mods/niceties Discord: https://discord.gg/Vwh2y7qMXv
